title: Model health
description: Champion vs shadow challengers on the same reviews; calibration; drift; the gate.

options.content: Every review is predicted by every active model *before* the answer (shadow mode). Only reviews **at least a day** after the card's previous review count: minutes after learning every model says ~100%. Lower log loss is better; a calibrated model's *predicted* line sits on the *actual* line. The gate promotes an FSRS challenger after 300 such reviews if it wins log loss in 95% of bootstrap resamples and is not worse calibrated.

panels.title: Log loss per model (shared reviews, daily)
panels.description: Mean log loss per day on the reviews that every active model predicted. Lower is better.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT id, card_id, reviewed_at, (grade > 1)::int AS recalled,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM reviewed_at - lag(reviewed_at) OVER (
           PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY reviewed_at, id)) / 86400 AS gap_days
  FROM reviews
), active AS (SELECT version FROM memory_models WHERE role IN ('champion', 'challenger')),
p AS (
  SELECT p.review_id, p.model_version, r.reviewed_at, -(r.recalled * ln(greatest(least(p.predicted_recall, 1 - 1e-6), 1e-6)) + (1 - r.recalled) * ln(1 - greatest(least(p.predicted_recall, 1 - 1e-6), 1e-6))) AS loss
  FROM predictions p JOIN r ON r.id = p.review_id
  WHERE r.gap_days >= 1 AND p.model_version IN (SELECT version FROM active)
    AND $__timeFilter(r.reviewed_at)
),
shared AS (
  SELECT review_id FROM p GROUP BY review_id
  HAVING count(*) = (SELECT count(*) FROM active)
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(reviewed_at, '1d'), model_version AS metric, avg(loss) AS value
FROM p WHERE review_id IN (SELECT review_id FROM shared)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Gate evidence per challenger
panels.description: How much evidence each challenger has collected against the current champion.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT id, card_id, reviewed_at, (grade > 1)::int AS recalled,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM reviewed_at - lag(reviewed_at) OVER (
           PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY reviewed_at, id)) / 86400 AS gap_days
  FROM reviews
),
champion AS (SELECT version FROM memory_models WHERE role = 'champion'),
counted AS (
  SELECT q.review_id FROM predictions q JOIN r ON r.id = q.review_id
  WHERE r.gap_days >= 1 AND q.model_version = (SELECT version FROM champion)
)
SELECT m.version AS "challenger", m.kind AS "kind", m.created_at AS "registered",
       count(p.review_id) AS "shared reviews (≥ 1 day)",
       CASE WHEN m.kind = 'fsrs' THEN 300 END AS "needed",
       CASE WHEN m.kind = 'fsrs' THEN 'can be promoted' ELSE 'compared only' END AS "note"
FROM memory_models m
LEFT JOIN predictions p
  ON p.model_version = m.version AND p.review_id IN (SELECT review_id FROM counted)
WHERE m.role = 'challenger'
GROUP BY m.version, m.kind, m.created_at ORDER BY m.created_at

panels.title: Champion: predicted vs actual recall (daily)
panels.description: Drift shows up as the two lines drifting apart: the model expects more (or less) than the learner actually recalls, e.g. after a break.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT id, card_id, reviewed_at, (grade > 1)::int AS recalled,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM reviewed_at - lag(reviewed_at) OVER (
           PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY reviewed_at, id)) / 86400 AS gap_days
  FROM reviews
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.reviewed_at, '1d'),
       avg(p.predicted_recall) AS "predicted", avg(r.recalled) AS "actual"
FROM r JOIN predictions p ON p.review_id = r.id AND p.is_champion
WHERE r.gap_days >= 1 AND $__timeFilter(r.reviewed_at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Calibration of the champion (time range)
panels.description: Per bin of predicted recall: what the champion said and how often the card was actually recalled. Equal bars mean a calibrated model.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT id, card_id, reviewed_at, (grade > 1)::int AS recalled,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM reviewed_at - lag(reviewed_at) OVER (
           PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY reviewed_at, id)) / 86400 AS gap_days
  FROM reviews
),
b AS (
  SELECT least(floor(p.predicted_recall * 10), 9)::int AS bin, p.predicted_recall, r.recalled
  FROM r JOIN predictions p ON p.review_id = r.id AND p.is_champion
  WHERE r.gap_days >= 1 AND $__timeFilter(r.reviewed_at)
)
SELECT (bin * 10) || '–' || (bin * 10 + 10) || '%' AS "predicted bin",
       avg(predicted_recall) AS "predicted", avg(recalled) AS "actual", count(*) AS "reviews"
FROM b GROUP BY bin ORDER BY bin

panels.title: Calibration of every active model (time range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT id, card_id, reviewed_at, (grade > 1)::int AS recalled,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM reviewed_at - lag(reviewed_at) OVER (
           PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY reviewed_at, id)) / 86400 AS gap_days
  FROM reviews
), active AS (SELECT version FROM memory_models WHERE role IN ('champion', 'challenger'))
SELECT p.model_version AS "model",
       (least(floor(p.predicted_recall * 10), 9)::int * 10) || '%+' AS "predicted bin",
       count(*) AS "reviews",
       round(avg(p.predicted_recall)::numeric, 3) AS "predicted",
       round(avg(r.recalled)::numeric, 3) AS "actual"
FROM r JOIN predictions p ON p.review_id = r.id
WHERE r.gap_days >= 1 AND p.model_version IN (SELECT version FROM active)
  AND $__timeFilter(r.reviewed_at)
GROUP BY 1, least(floor(p.predicted_recall * 10), 9)::int ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Predictions logged per model (daily)
panels.description: Shadow-mode coverage: every active model should predict every review after the first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.reviewed_at, '1d'), p.model_version AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM predictions p JOIN reviews r ON r.id = p.review_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.reviewed_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT version, kind, role, trained_on_reviews AS "trained on reviews",
       trained_until AS "trained until", created_at AS "registered", notes
FROM memory_models ORDER BY created_at DESC

panels.title: Promotion history
panels.description: Every change of champion: by the gate (with its evidence) or a manual rollback.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT promoted_at AS "when", previous_version || ' → ' || version AS "change", reason,
       evaluation->>'n' AS "reviews",
       round((evaluation->>'p_better')::numeric, 3) AS "p better",
       round((evaluation->>'champion_log_loss')::numeric, 4) AS "old log loss",
       round((evaluation->>'challenger_log_loss')::numeric, 4) AS "new log loss",
       cards_rebuilt AS "cards rebuilt"
FROM model_promotions ORDER BY promoted_at DESC
